paragraphs: Metrasens sells detection technology for screening people, which its homepage describes as detecting risk items. The homepage names one such system, Metrasens Ultra, for people screening in varied environments and for detecting ferrous threats. Screening is presented as something that adapts to an existing space rather than disrupting it.

The case studies page names a department of corrections as a long-term partner in contraband detection. Other stories on the same page name Tulsa Public Schools, Hennepin County Medical Center, Children's Mercy and Children's Hospital of Colorado. Taken together the entries put screening in schools, hospitals, jails and one technology company, rather than in a single market.

quote.text: When you have to find the items that need to be found, precision is the top priority.
